statement: The 0.2 release verification frontiers have an honest producer: scripts/checks/run-release-0-2-verification-scenarios.js (npm run release:verify:scenarios) derives the release-0-2-verification-v3-memory-soak, -local-artifacts and -remote-exact-sha probe reports and the aggregate release-0-2-verification-v3 report from recorded facts only — the newest memory-soak report (every node analyzed with at least 30 samples, no insufficient-analysis reason, no detected leak, and a matching src fingerprint), local gate receipts written by scripts/checks/record-release-gate-receipt.js (which spawns the real command and records its real exit code, HEAD sha, src fingerprint at start and finish, and version) for test-gate, test-ci, release-workflow-contracts, package-npm, build-all, docker-smoke and helm-package, and a GitHub check receipt written by scripts/checks/record-github-gate-receipt.js for the exact HEAD sha's ci / gate conclusion — with one verdict owner (release-0-2-verification-derivation.js), typed fail-closed reasons for every missing or mismatched input, and provenance bound to the frozen identity (HEAD sha, src fingerprint, 0.2.0 in package.json, CLI_VERSION, ENTRYPOINT_VERSION and the Helm chart); the commands are registered (package.json, list-commands, tool-descriptions, RELEASE.md). Nothing publishes, pushes or tags. Proven deterministically on temp directories with an injected GitHub query: red on HEAD (producer absent), green after; existing scenario runners unchanged.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Verdicts are derived only in release-0-2-verification-derivation.js; the two receipt helpers record facts (real exit code, queried conclusion) and never emit passed or verdict.

Every scenario is fail-closed: an absent soak report, gate receipt, or GitHub receipt is FAIL with a typed reason, never skipped or non-measuring; every report is provenance-bound to one frozen identity (HEAD sha, src fingerprint, 0.2.0 in all five version sources) and any inconsistency fails all four scenarios.
The witness never touches the network or the tracked test-output; the GitHub query is injected; nothing in this Quest publishes, pushes, or tags.
No src/ file changes; ratchet baselines, guideline checkers, and the existing release scenario runners are unchanged (control receipt green before and after).
Proof is a deterministic node:test witness on temp directories, red on HEAD (producer absent) and green after, with existing-scenario-runners-unchanged as the control that must stay green.
